beats.text: Sunday brunch, rooftop off Bourdillon. Ten minutes before, she texts: 'Babe I'm coming with my friends 🥰'.
Meet Simi, Teni and Lola. They're starving. We're all starving.
{tell}

main_boyfriend.text: Lola scrolls Tiwa's close-friends story at the table: a man's hand on a steering wheel, a Patek on the wrist. Lola locks the phone fast.

vendor_debt.text: Her phone buzzes on the table. 'Hair Vendor 🦋' — nine missed calls. She flips it face down and orders the lobster.

tester.text: While the friends order, Tiwa leans in: 'Send 50k. Let me see something.' She watches your face, not your phone.

choices.label: Pay for the whole squad. Bottomless mimosas.
choices.broke_text: Your account looked at the mimosa menu and fainted.
choices.receipt: You paid brunch for Tiwa and three friends you'd just met.

outcomes.text: Four girls, one bill. The friends post you as 'Tiwa's new sponsor 🤑'. Tiwa glows like a ring light.

tester.text: She watches you pay without blinking. In the car: 'You didn't even ask why I brought them.' She sounds disappointed, not grateful.

choices.label: Pay for Tiwa. The friends can pay for the friends.
choices.receipt: You paid for Tiwa only and left the friends to their own cards.

outcomes.text: Simi gasps like you slapped her. Teni's card declines twice. Tiwa laughs into her napkin and doesn't defend them.

tester.text: Tiwa laughs so hard she cries. 'Finally. Somebody with sense.' The friends leave early. She doesn't.

choices.label: "I invited you, Tiwa. Not the group chat."
choices.receipt: You told Tiwa you invited her, not her group chat.

outcomes.text: Silence. Lola mutters 'it's giving broke'. Tiwa sends them to the bar. Dignity cost: ₦0. Vibes cost: some.

tester.text: She sends them away with a wink. They were never staying. 'You passed. Small.'

choices.label: Ignore the squad. Ask Tiwa about her mum.
choices.receipt: You ignored the squad and asked about her mum.

outcomes.text: For one full minute she forgets the camera. Her mum sells adire in Abeokuta. Then Simi says, 'Is this an interview?'

choices.label: [Lover] Write her a poem on a napkin. Slide it over.
choices.receipt: You wrote Tiwa a poem on a brunch napkin.

outcomes.text: She reads it twice and puts it in her bag, not on her story. Later you find out it's still in there.

choices.label: [Big Boy] Order a champagne tower. Let Lagos see.
choices.receipt: You ordered a champagne tower on your first date.

outcomes.text: The rooftop films you. The friends film you. Tiwa films you. You are content now.

tester.text: She doesn't film it. She just looks at you: 'So this is how you get people.'

beats.text: Three hours before your first date, a text: her account number. Then: 'For transport 🥺 Lekki to Ikoyi is far.' It is eleven minutes.
Babe, you know how Lagos is. I just want to arrive looking fresh for you.
{tell}

main_boyfriend.text: Her voice note after the account number: 'Thank you, Deji— babe. Thank you, babe.'

vendor_debt.text: You check her page while you wait. Under her latest post: 'Tiwa pay me my money. Lashes since January 😡'.

tester.text: A second text: 'Actually, send 50k. Let me see something.' Then: 'Kidding. Unless?'

choices.label: Send ₦10k. Uber, not Uber Black.
choices.receipt: You sent Tiwa ₦10k for transport before the first date.

outcomes.text: Voice note, laughing: 'Ten thousand. Okay, Budget Bae.' She still comes. On time, even. In something that cost more than your rent.

tester.text: She arrives in a ₦3,500 Bolt and shows you the receipt. 'Change is yours.' She keeps the change anyway.

choices.label: Send ₦50k. "Keep the change, fine girl."
choices.receipt: You sent Tiwa ₦50k 'for transport'.

outcomes.text: She arrives in a G-Wagon that is definitely not an Uber. 'Thank you baby 😘'. The ₦50k was for vibes.

tester.text: She arrives in a ₦4k Bolt and looks at you for a long time. 'You send money like it's nothing. Who taught you that?'

choices.label: "Send your location. I'll book the ride."
choices.receipt: You offered to book her ride instead of sending cash.

tester.text: She gets in the car laughing: 'You don't trust me with ₦10k?' 'No.' 'Good.' She smiles all through dinner.

choices.label: Borrow your cousin's Corolla. Pick her up yourself.
choices.receipt: You picked Tiwa up in a borrowed Corolla.

main_boyfriend.text: She makes you park two streets away. 'My estate is strict.' No estate in Lekki is that strict.

choices.label: [Corporate] Send ₦7,850 with an itemised breakdown.
choices.receipt: You sent Tiwa an itemised transport budget.

choices.label: [Runs] Send ₦5k and a 'network issue' screenshot.

beats.text: Date night at her glass flat in Lekki Phase 1. Two ring lights, a tripod, a wine glass she never drinks from.

{tell}

choices.receipt: You cooked on camera for Tiwa's page.

choices.label: "Turn it off. I came for you, not your followers."
choices.receipt: You asked Tiwa to switch off the ring light.

main_boyfriend.text: She switches it off. Her phone lights up face down on the counter, twice. She lets it ring. You both pretend it isn't.

choices.label: Cancel the cooking show. Order suya.
choices.receipt: You cancelled the cooking video and ordered suya.

choices.label: [Big Boy] Hire a private chef. Let her film him.

choices.receipt: You replied to her story with a clown emoji.

choices.receipt: You asked Tiwa to send your ₦50k back.

outcomes.text: 'Wow. It's always the ones who send small.' Nothing returns. She mutes you for an hour.

main_boyfriend.text: ₦50k returns in four minutes from an account named 'DEJI A.'. She didn't even pay you back herself.

vendor_debt.text: 'I'll send it Friday.' Friday is a concept. ₦12k arrives with 'small small 🙏'.

tester.text: ₦50k returns with a voice note: 'Good. Never let anybody finish your money and post another person.' She sounds proud.

choices.label: Send another ₦50k. "I trust you."
choices.receipt: You sent another ₦50k with 'I trust you'.

outcomes.text: 'Awww 🥹 you're so different.' Her next story: the same lounge, a second bottle.

main_boyfriend.text: 'You're the best.' The next story: a bottle with sparklers. The Patek is holding it.

She sees you. Her face does four things. The man asks who you are. She says, 'My driver.'

Mm. Thank you for today...
{tell}

main_boyfriend.text: '...Deji.' She called you Deji. She's asleep, or she's pretending.

vendor_debt.text: Her phone buzzes nine times on the table. 'Hair Vendor 🦋'. She declines every call without opening her eyes.

choices.label: Let her sleep. Lagos is tiring.
choices.receipt: You let it go and let her sleep.

outcomes.text: You pick the next episode. She drools on your shirt. It's sweet, mostly. You'll think about it at 3am.

choices.label: Check her phone while she sleeps.
choices.receipt: You went through Tiwa's phone while she slept.

main_boyfriend.text: Lock screen: a man's hand, a Patek, a ring emoji and 'Deji 🔒'. You put it down like it's hot.
She opens one eye. 'Are you okay?' Her phone is in your hand. Nobody is okay.

She opens one eye. 'Are you okay?' Her phone is in your hand. Nobody is okay.

She opens one eye. 'Are you okay?' Her phone is in your hand. Nobody is okay.

choices.receipt: You ordered midnight shawarma on her account.

{tell}

choices.label: Send ₦35k for a week of Bolts.
choices.receipt: You sent Tiwa ₦35k for a week of rides.

choices.label: Share one Bolt. Ride with her.
choices.receipt: You shared a ride home with her.

choices.receipt: You asked to go and see the car at the mechanic.

choices.label: "Let's walk to the junction. Like real people."
choices.receipt: You made Tiwa walk to the junction with you.

outcomes.text: She walks in heels on Admiralty Way and complains the whole time. By the junction, she's holding your hand.

choices.receipt: You reminded her that her weekends are 'for family'.

choices.receipt: You offered Tiwa a documented car-repair loan.

choices.receipt: You sent Funmi a ₦20k cake instead of cash.

tester.text: Funmi FaceTimes you herself. 'You're the first one who didn't just send cash. Tiwa is crying.'

choices.label: [Big Boy] Buy Funmi an actual Birkin. Watch the family fold.
choices.receipt: You bought her sister an actual Birkin.

outcomes.text: Her mother calls you 'our in-law'. Three aunties follow you. You are now a family asset.

₦350k today or I cut it. On her head. On camera.
{tell}

vendor_debt.text: Tiwa's bag keeps ringing: 'Car Vendor', 'Lash Vendor', 'Mama Kemi 2'. Mama Kemi is standing right here.

main_boyfriend.text: Tiwa, panicking, calls you 'Deji' twice. 'Babe. Babe. You, babe.'

choices.label: Pay the ₦350k. Save the frontal.
choices.receipt: You paid Mama Kemi ₦350k to save Tiwa's frontal.

choices.receipt: You paid Mama Kemi ₦50k to calm things down.

vendor_debt.text: Mama Kemi opens a notebook: 'Car, lashes, hair, bags. ₦4.2m total.' Tiwa stares at the floor tiles.

tester.text: Mama Kemi tears up the napkin. 'She doesn't owe me. She wanted to see what you'd do.' Tiwa: 'Sorry.'

choices.label: Walk out. Not your frontal, not your wahala.
choices.receipt: You walked out on the frontal hostage situation.

Tiwa. My car is outside. Your seat is in it.

main_boyfriend.text: 'Ask her where she sleeps on Saturdays.' Forty brunch tables now know. She picks up her bag.

vendor_debt.text: 'Ask her about my car payment!' The whole rooftop now knows about the car.

choices.label: [Big Boy] Toss him your G-Wagon keys. "Mine's newer."
choices.receipt: You flexed your own G-Wagon on Deji.

outcomes.text: The rooftop gasps. Deji leaves. Tiwa looks at you like a new episode just dropped.

choices.label: [Lover] Ask her to dance. Right there, by the rail.
choices.receipt: You asked Tiwa to dance in front of Deji.

outcomes.text: No music, just the DJ's playlist. She dances anyway. Deji's roses wilt on the table.

beats.text: Admiralty Way salon. Her ring light snaps on. She's live. 40,000 people watching.
Guys, meet my... my person! Say hi to the babies 🥰
{tell}

vendor_debt.text: A comment floats up: 'Tiwa pay your lash girl before you introduce anybody 😂'. Forty laughing emojis follow.

main_boyfriend.text: A comment: 'Isn't this the Patek guy's babe? 👀' Tiwa blocks the account mid-sentence.

tester.text: When the live ends, the ring light stays on. She stares into it. Her eyes are wet. 'It's the light,' she says.

choices.label: Wave. Do the dance she taught you.
choices.receipt: You danced on Tiwa's live.

outcomes.text: 15,000 likes. The comments ship you. A blog screenshots it. You are now 'Tiwa's new one'.

choices.label: Step out of frame. "Not on camera, babe."
choices.receipt: You stepped out of Tiwa's live.

outcomes.text: She keeps smiling for the live, but her eyes follow you out. After: 'You're embarrassed of me?'

tester.text: She ends the live early. 'I love that you don't want them. I'm so tired of them.'

choices.label: Read the nastiest comment out loud. Live.
choices.receipt: You read a vendor's comment out loud on Tiwa's live.

outcomes.text: 40,000 people hear 'pay your lash girl'. She smiles through it like a hostage. The live ends.

vendor_debt.text: 40,000 people hear 'pay your lash girl'. Then twelve more vendors join the comments. The live ends itself.

choices.label: Hold the ring light for her. Be crew.
choices.receipt: You held Tiwa's ring light through her live.

outcomes.text: Two hours, one arm, zero credit. Afterwards she kisses your shoulder: 'Best crew I've ever had.'

choices.label: "Your ring light's off. Talk to me."
choices.receipt: You noticed her ring light was off and asked her to talk.

outcomes.text: After the live, the light clicks off. 'Okay. Okay. Let me tell you.'

main_boyfriend.text: 'You noticed?' She almost tells you something. Then her phone rings. 'Later.'

vendor_debt.text: She tells you about the ₦4.2m. Every vendor. Every lie. It takes an hour and a whole box of tissues.

tester.text: 'Nobody ever remembers that.' She cries, finally, for real. Then laughs at herself.

choices.label: [Runs] Plug your hustle in her comments.
choices.receipt: You plugged your business on Tiwa's live.

outcomes.text: Your WhatsApp gets 300 messages. Tiwa sends you an invoice for 'airtime'. She's not joking.

beats.text: Her cousin's owambe in Surulere. The aso-ebi nobody told you about costs ₦45k. Aunty Bisi has you by the wrist.
So you are the one? When are you coming to see her father?
{tell}

main_boyfriend.text: Aunty Bisi, louder: 'Tiwa, where is the other one? The one who comes every weekend?' Tiwa: 'Aunty, jollof is finishing.'

vendor_debt.text: The aso-ebi coordinator corners Tiwa by the canopy: 'Your balance since March. I won't shout in front of your guest.' She shouts.

tester.text: Her mother hugs you too long. Tiwa disappears to the car. When she comes back her mascara is fixed. Her eyes aren't.

choices.label: Buy the aso-ebi. Dance with the aunties.
choices.receipt: You bought aso-ebi and danced with her aunties.

outcomes.text: Aunty Bisi sprays you ₦500 notes. Tiwa watches you dance with her family and forgets to film.

main_boyfriend.text: The aunties love you. One asks, loudly, if you're 'the weekday one'. Tiwa laughs too long.

choices.label: Come in jeans. Dance anyway.
choices.receipt: You danced at the owambe in jeans.

outcomes.text: The aunties call you 'the one in jeans'. By the end of the night it's affectionate.

choices.label: "Next month, Aunty. I'll bring kola."
choices.receipt: You promised Aunty Bisi you'd come and see Tiwa's father.

outcomes.text: Aunty Bisi announces it to the canopy. Tiwa chokes on her Chapman. You are engaged now, culturally.

tester.text: Tiwa doesn't laugh it off. She looks at you like she's checking whether you meant it.

main_boyfriend.text: Tiwa drags you to the car. 'Why would you say that?' Not 'are you serious'. Why.

choices.label: Find her ewa agoyin. Not jollof.
choices.receipt: You found Tiwa a plate of ewa agoyin at the owambe.

outcomes.text: She stares at the beans. 'You remembered?' She eats it in her gele, on the kerb, happiest you've ever seen her.

choices.label: [Sugar] Let the aunties spray you. Collect quietly.
choices.receipt: You collected the aunties' owambe spray money.

outcomes.text: ₦38k in ₦500 notes. Tiwa is impressed and slightly threatened.

beats.text: Her flat, Saturday, 10pm. A key turns in the door. Not hers. A man in a Patek walks in carrying groceries.
Tiwa, who is this? And why are they wearing my slippers?
{tell}

main_boyfriend.text: Tiwa, frozen, says the only thing she can: 'Deji, babe, this is— Deji.' She says his name twice. Neither time to you.

choices.label: "Tiwa. Choose. Now."
choices.receipt: You told Tiwa to choose, right there.

outcomes.text: She looks at Deji. Then at you. 'Deji, give me my key.' He does. He leaves. Then she cries on your chest for an hour.
She looks at Deji for too long. That's the answer. You let yourself out.

choices.label: "I'll leave quietly. For a fee."
choices.receipt: You charged Deji for your silence.

outcomes.text: Deji transfers ₦1m without looking up. 'Don't come back.' Tiwa doesn't stop you.

choices.label: Post the whole thing. Slippers and all.
choices.receipt: You posted the main boyfriend showdown online.

outcomes.text: The Parlour feasts: 'ATM meets the main character.' Her 200k followers watch her get exposed in HD.

choices.label: "It's fine. I'm the weekday one."
choices.receipt: You agreed to be Tiwa's weekday one.

outcomes.text: Deji shrugs. Tiwa exhales. You've just signed up for weekdays only. She's sweeter to you than ever.

choices.label: Take off his slippers. Walk out barefoot.
choices.receipt: You took off Deji's slippers and walked out.

outcomes.text: Admiralty Way at night, barefoot. A keke driver asks no questions. Respect.

choices.label: "Deji. The G-Wagon. Of course."
choices.receipt: You called Deji by name before anyone introduced him.

outcomes.text: Deji: 'You know me?' Tiwa: 'They know everything.' You do, actually.

choices.label: "Weekends are for family. You're the family?"
choices.receipt: You quoted her 'weekends are for family' line at Deji.

outcomes.text: Deji laughs, bitterly. 'Family? I'm the boyfriend. Weekdays are for her sponsors.' Sponsors. Plural.

choices.label: "I saw you both at the lounge in VI."
choices.receipt: You told them you'd seen them at the lounge in VI.

outcomes.text: Tiwa sits down on the floor. 'I'm tired. I'm so tired of this.' Deji, for the first time, looks at her properly.

beats.text: 7am. Banging on her door: Mama Kemi, the lash girl, the car dealer's boy and a man with a tow truck.
₦4.2 million! Today! Or we carry everything, including your new babe!
{tell}

vendor_debt.text: Through the window, the G-Wagon is already on the tow truck. It was never with the mechanic.

choices.label: Sit them down. Make a payment plan together.
choices.receipt: You sat down with her vendors and made a payment plan.

outcomes.text: Three hours on her floor with a calculator. She signs everything. 'Nobody has ever stayed for the boring part.'

choices.label: Pay one vendor. Buy her an hour.
choices.receipt: You paid one of Tiwa's vendors to buy her time.

outcomes.text: Mama Kemi takes it and goes. The others stay. One hour bought. Tiwa holds your arm the whole hour.

choices.label: Sell the gist to a blog. ₦800k.
choices.receipt: You sold Tiwa's debt story to a blog.

outcomes.text: The blog pays. 'Soft-life influencer owes ₦4.2m.' You're rich and you're the villain.

choices.label: Climb out the back. Block everyone.
choices.receipt: You climbed over her back fence and blocked everyone.

outcomes.text: Your shirt doesn't make it over the fence. You do. Lekki Phase 1 at 7am, half dressed, free.

choices.label: "Your car is with the mechanic, abi?"
choices.receipt: You asked if the car was 'with the mechanic'.

outcomes.text: She laughs. Then cries. Then laughs. 'The mechanic is a tow truck.'

choices.label: "No invoices. Now I know why."
choices.receipt: You told her you finally understood the missing invoices.

outcomes.text: 'I sent the wrong folder on purpose. I wanted you to find out without me saying it.'

choices.label: "Mama Kemi, I paid you last week!"
choices.receipt: You reminded Mama Kemi you'd already paid her.

outcomes.text: Mama Kemi: 'You paid March. This is the April of March.' She leaves the frontal. Nobody leaves the car.

choices.label: "Mama Kemi. The one I shouldn't pick."
choices.receipt: You told Mama Kemi that Tiwa said not to pick her calls.

outcomes.text: Mama Kemi turns to Tiwa: 'You told people not to pick me?' Tiwa: 'Mummy, please.' Even the tow man laughs.

beats.text: Her flat. On the table: an envelope, the AirPods, the perfume, a list of every naira you ever sent. Her ring light is off.
I test everybody. With money. I'm sorry. You're the first one I wanted to pass.
{tell}

tester.text: The envelope is fat. Every transfer, in cash, counted twice. A note: 'Returned. Not because I don't want you.'

choices.label: Pick up the envelope. Then pick her up.
choices.receipt: You forgave the tests and hugged her.

outcomes.text: She laughs into your neck. 'You're supposed to be angry.' 'Tomorrow.' The envelope stays on the table.

choices.label: "You tested me? Like an exam?"
choices.receipt: You asked Tiwa why she tested you like an exam.

outcomes.text: 'Yes. Like an exam. Because the last four all failed.' She says it without blinking. Then she blinks a lot.

choices.label: Take the envelope. Leave. "Test passed, babe."
choices.receipt: You took the envelope and left Tiwa.

outcomes.text: You take the money and the moral high ground. Both feel lighter than you expected.

choices.label: Post it: 'She tested me 😂'.
choices.receipt: You posted about Tiwa testing you.

outcomes.text: The Parlour roasts her for a week. She deletes her page. The envelope is still on the table.

choices.label: Switch the ring light on. "Say it to them too."
choices.receipt: You turned on her ring light and asked her to say it publicly.

outcomes.text: She goes live. No filter, no frontal. 'I'm done testing people. I found one.' 40k people watch her mean it.

choices.label: "Let's discuss it over ewa agoyin."
choices.receipt: You talked it out with Tiwa over ewa agoyin.

outcomes.text: Beans on her marble floor at midnight. She tells you every test. You tell her which ones you noticed.

choices.label: "Every transfer, I was testing you back."
choices.receipt: You told Tiwa every transfer was you testing her back.

outcomes.text: She stares. Then laughs. 'Liar.' 'A little.' 'Okay. You're my person.'

beats.text: A day after your last transfer to Tiwa, your phone buzzes twice.
Babe, can we talk about the money you sent?

choices.label: Open the chat. Brace.
choices.receipt: You opened Tiwa's message about the money.

outcomes.text: 'Thank you again 🥰' That's it. That's the whole message.

main_boyfriend.text: 'Can you send it again? The first one... went somewhere.' A Patek glints in her selfie.

vendor_debt.text: Mama Kemi texts you directly: 'Thank you for paying Tiwa's hair balance. She still owes ₦3.8m. Your number is in my book now.'

tester.text: A transfer: every naira back, plus ₦5k. 'Interest. You passed the money part. Now the hard part: just be here.'

choices.label: Leave it on read. Money talk is cursed.
choices.receipt: You left Tiwa's money message on read.

outcomes.text: She sends a sticker of a crying cat. Then nothing. Peace, sort of.

choices.label: "Actually, can I have it back?"
choices.receipt: You asked Tiwa for your money back.

outcomes.text: 'Wow.' Then ₦20k. Then 'Don't speak to me today.'

main_boyfriend.text: Nothing. Then a ₦0.01 transfer from 'DEJI A.' with the narration 'lol'.

tester.text: All of it, instantly, with a voice note: 'Good. Ask for what's yours. I like that.'

choices.label: "It's yours. I just want you."
choices.receipt: You told Tiwa the money was hers and you just wanted her.

outcomes.text: Three hearts. Then a long voice note that is mostly breathing and 'you're so silly'.

main_boyfriend.text: Three hearts. Then 'Can't talk, family stuff.' It's Saturday.

beats.text: A clown emoji. On my story. My cousins saw it. My followers saw it. Explain yourself.

choices.label: "You posted another person with my lash money."
choices.receipt: You owned the clown emoji and explained why.

outcomes.text: She opens her mouth. Closes it. 'Okay. That's... fair.' She doesn't like how fair it is.

tester.text: She laughs. 'Fair. The caption was cringe.' Then: 'Uncle Tunde said you have sense.'

choices.label: "Sorry. Jealousy. It won't happen again."
choices.receipt: You apologised for the clown emoji.

outcomes.text: 'It better not.' She makes you pick brunch for Sunday. She picks the most expensive one anyway.

choices.label: Send another clown. Bigger.
choices.receipt: You sent a second, bigger clown emoji.

outcomes.text: She blocks you for six hours. Then unblocks you to send '🤡 yourself'. Romance is dead. Clowns live.

beats.text: A DM from a verified account. Profile picture: a white G-Wagon.
Let's talk about Tiwa. Just us. Lunch on me.

choices.label: Meet him. Hear him out.
choices.receipt: You met Deji, the man from the G-Wagon.

outcomes.text: He talks about his car for an hour. You learn nothing about Tiwa and everything about torque.

main_boyfriend.text: He scrolls their couple photos back to 2022. 'You're the fourth this year. She always comes back.'

vendor_debt.text: 'She owes me ₦1.9m for the car. Help me collect and I'll give you 20%.' He pays for lunch in advance, ₦150k.

tester.text: 'She returned everything I ever bought her. Everything. What did you do?' He sounds genuinely wounded.

choices.label: Forward the DM to Tiwa.
choices.receipt: You forwarded Deji's DM to Tiwa.

outcomes.text: 'Ignore him.' Short. Firm. You do.

main_boyfriend.text: 'Ignore him. He's obsessed.' He is. With her. Because she's his.

vendor_debt.text: 'He wants his car. I'll handle it.' She can't. You can hear that she can't.

tester.text: She three-ways him: 'Deji, it's over. Stop texting my person.' Click. Cinema.

choices.label: Block him. Lunch is not free.
choices.receipt: You blocked Deji without replying.

outcomes.text: Blocked. Somewhere in Lekki, a G-Wagon revs in frustration.

beats.text: Your boss forwards a TikTok to the office WhatsApp group. It's you. On Tiwa's page. 312,000 views.
Is this why your Monday reports are late? 😂

choices.label: "Yes, that's me. Chef and co-star."
choices.receipt: You owned your appearance on Tiwa's page at work.

outcomes.text: The office group explodes with 😂. HR sends a sticker. You are now a work legend.

main_boyfriend.text: Under the clip, a comment: 'Deji, see your babe with another person 😂'. 300 likes.

vendor_debt.text: A vendor comments under the clip: 'Is this the new sponsor? Tell them to pay her balance.'

choices.label: Ask Tiwa to take it down.
choices.receipt: You asked Tiwa to take the clip down.

outcomes.text: 'Take down my best-performing post?' She archives it. Grudgingly. Engagement mourns.

tester.text: Already archived. 'I saw your boss in the comments. Sorry.' She noticed before you did.

choices.label: "Lol that's my twin."
choices.receipt: You told your boss the clip was your twin.

outcomes.text: Your boss: 'Your twin has your exact birthmark?' The group is quiet. Too quiet.

beats.text: Her story, 7am: an empty bowl of ewa agoyin. Caption: 'Best date of my life. No brunch. No filter.' 220,000 views.
Don't let it enter your head. ...Okay, let it enter small.

choices.label: Reply with one heart. Keep it soft.
choices.receipt: You replied to her agoyin story with a heart.

outcomes.text: She replies with a bean emoji. It's your thing now. You have a thing.

main_boyfriend.text: A reply from a Patek-wristed account appears on her story: '??'. She deletes the story by noon.

choices.label: Repost it: 'My person 🫘'.
choices.receipt: You reposted Tiwa's agoyin story.

outcomes.text: Her followers find your page. Your followers find hers. A bean shop in Ojuelegba gets 40 new orders.

choices.label: Send her another bowl. Same woman, same bridge.
choices.receipt: You sent Tiwa another bowl of ewa agoyin.

outcomes.text: The dispatch rider sends you a photo of her face when she opens it. You will keep that photo forever.

beats.text: Babe, I'm at Bisola's in Yaba. She's the only lash girl in Lagos I trust. Island lash techs are scammers. Okay bye, kisses 💋

choices.label: "Bisola in Yaba. The trusted one. Noted 😌"
choices.receipt: You noted Bisola, her lash girl in Yaba.

outcomes.text: 'Look at you, listening.' She sends a blurry lash selfie as a reward.

choices.label: "Send pics when you're done 😍"
choices.receipt: You asked for lash pics.

outcomes.text: Eleven pictures. Same angle. You say all eleven are your favourite.

choices.label: "How much are lashes these days?"
choices.receipt: You asked Tiwa how much lashes cost.

outcomes.text: 'Why? You want to sponsor?' Every ₦0 conversation is her nightmare.

beats.text: Hey you 🥰 heads up, I don't really text on weekends. Family things in Ikeja GRA. Don't be weird about it, okay?

choices.label: "Weekends are family. Got it 👍"
choices.receipt: You noted that Tiwa's weekends are 'for family'.

outcomes.text: 'See? Easy.' A heart. You file it away anyway.

choices.label: "Family is everything 🙏"
choices.receipt: You told Tiwa family is everything.

outcomes.text: 'Exactly!!' Three praying hands. Nobody mentions which family.

choices.label: "Weekends are the only time I'm free though 😩"
choices.receipt: You complained that weekends are your only free time.

outcomes.text: 'Weekdays are better for us anyway.' Us. Weekdays.

beats.text: If anybody called Mama Kemi calls your number, don't pick. She's this crazy aunty from the salon. Long story. Miss you, bye!

choices.label: "How does Mama Kemi have my number? 👀"
choices.receipt: You asked how Mama Kemi got your number.

outcomes.text: 'Lagos is small!' Laughing emoji. Not an answer. You remember the name.

choices.label: "Okay, I won't pick 😂"
choices.receipt: You promised not to pick Mama Kemi's calls.

outcomes.text: 'Good. You're my favourite.' Crisis managed. Hers, not yours.

choices.label: "Miss you more 🥺"
choices.receipt: You told Tiwa you missed her more.

outcomes.text: A voice note of her singing 'miss you more' badly. You play it twice.

beats.text: Can I confess something? I hate brunch. I'd kill for ewa agoyin from the woman under Ojuelegba bridge. Don't tell my followers 🤫

choices.label: "Ewa agoyin under the bridge. Your secret is safe."
choices.receipt: You kept Tiwa's ewa agoyin secret.

outcomes.text: 'Swear?' 'Swear.' She sends a voice note that's just her laughing for nine seconds.

choices.label: "But your brunch pictures are so cute though"
choices.receipt: You told her the brunch pictures were cute.

outcomes.text: 'Exactly. Pictures.' She leaves you on read, thoughtfully.

choices.label: "Send me your account number for beans 😂"
choices.receipt: You joked about sending money for beans.

outcomes.text: She actually sends it. ₦0 was transferred. A friendship was tested.

beats.text: Random thing. If my ring light is off and I'm not posting, I'm not okay. Call, don't text. Anyway! Brunch Sunday?

choices.label: "Ring light off means call. I'll call."
choices.receipt: You promised to call when her ring light is off.

outcomes.text: She goes quiet for a second. 'Thank you.' Then, fast: 'Brunch though?'

choices.label: "Brunch Sunday, yes! Where?"
choices.receipt: You said yes to Sunday brunch.

outcomes.text: She sends four restaurant links. All in VI. All 'small chops from ₦18k'.

choices.label: "Lol you're so dramatic"
choices.receipt: You called Tiwa dramatic.

outcomes.text: 'Lol yes 😂' Too fast. She changes the subject to shoes.

beats.text: Funmi turns 21 this month 😭 my baby sister. Third of four girls. Everybody forgets her. Not me.

choices.label: "21! Third of four. Tell Funmi I said hi."
choices.receipt: You remembered Funmi, the third of four sisters.

outcomes.text: 'Why are you so sweet?' She screenshots it to the sisters' group.

choices.label: "Are we partying? 🎉"
choices.receipt: You asked if there would be a party.

outcomes.text: 'We? Hmm.' A thinking emoji. You are pending.

choices.label: "Everybody in your family has a birthday every month 😂"
choices.receipt: You joked about her family's birthday frequency.

outcomes.text: 'Are you calling my family scammers?' A pause. 'Okay, maybe Ronke.'
